items.source: Should not return the same instance of the ClassLoader returned from an invocation of LoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentableClassLoader().
items.translation: 不应返回从LoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentableClassLoader()调用中返回的ClassLoader的同一实例。

items.source: Please note that the above methods must reside in a class that is publicly accessible, although the class itself does not have to be visible to the application's class loader.
items.translation: 请注意，上述方法必须位于一个公开可访问的类中，尽管该类本身不必对应用程序的类加载器可见。

items.source:
The reflective nature of this LoadTimeWeaver is particularly useful when the
underlying ClassLoader implementation is loaded in a different class loader itself
(such as the application server's class loader which is not visible to the
web application). There is no direct API dependency between this LoadTimeWeaver
adapter and the underlying ClassLoader, just a 'loose' method contract.
items.translation: 这种 LoadTimeWeaver 的反射特性在底层 ClassLoader 实现本身由不同的类加载器加载时（例如应用程序服务器的类加载器，该加载器对 Web 应用程序不可见）特别有用。此 LoadTimeWeaver 适配器与底层 ClassLoader 之间没有直接的 API 依赖关系，仅存在一个“松散”的方法契约。
